verdict.rationale: Rive's docs confirm that multiple people can work on the same file at the same time, with automatic saving and all changes tracked in Revision History. That covers the core of simultaneous editing. However, the evidence never describes live cursors or real-time sync behavior, and no community or hands-on report corroborates the multiplayer experience. Missing for 10: live cursors/presence indicators, explicit instant real-time sync, independent corroboration of concurrent editing.
